supersedes.reason: The earlier comparison used the pre-optimization gMolAI inference path. This replacement reruns every encoder with the repository-canonical optimized gMolAI backend.

superseded_protocol_amendments.change: Replace an invalid near-elementwise equality gate with cosine and relative-L2 batch-stability gates while retaining exact, absolute, RMS, relative-L2, and cosine diagnostics.
superseded_protocol_amendments.diagnostic_basis: On an inference-only 1,024-molecule subset, batch-32 versus batch-8 gMolAI vectors had maximum absolute delta 0.01910 on values with maximum absolute magnitude 22.70, maximum per-row relative L2 delta 0.001196, and minimum cosine similarity 0.9999993.
superseded_protocol_amendments.scientific_impact: None: the model, checkpoint, calibrator, panel, timing boundary, batch sizes, condition order, measured-pass count, and representations are unchanged. The failed job produced no raw result record or final summary.

superseded_protocol_amendments.change: Replace bitwise equality for the repeated eight-molecule qualification fixture with frozen scale-aware repeatability gates while recording exact equality, absolute/RMS drift, relative-L2 drift, and cosine similarity.
superseded_protocol_amendments.diagnostic_basis: Two frozen SMI-TED-Light inference calls on the identical ordered eight-molecule fixture had maximum absolute delta 0.00020105 on values with maximum absolute magnitude 3.47425, RMS delta 0.00004075, maximum per-row relative-L2 delta 0.00008843, and minimum cosine similarity 0.9999999961.
superseded_protocol_amendments.scientific_impact: None: the model, checkpoint, panel, timing boundary, batch sizes, condition order, measured-pass count, and representations are unchanged. Partial job-1224835 outputs are archived and excluded; all seven encoders are rerun in one complete host/job execution.

superseded_protocol_amendments.change: Keep the frozen cross-batch integrity gates unchanged, but record rather than abort on KERMT v2's known native-path nonconformance so all three computational throughput points can be reported with an explicit output-nonequivalence warning.
superseded_protocol_amendments.diagnostic_basis: On the full common panel, native KERMT v2 batch-32 versus batch-8 output had minimum per-row cosine similarity 0.98383964 and maximum relative-L2 delta 0.18010095. A controlled affected group changed from adjacency width 3 to 4 and showed maximum relative-L2 delta 0.14886983; forcing identical width 4 reduced this to 0.00018176 with minimum cosine 0.99999998. The frozen encoder's nominal padding row had norms 16.60-23.09 rather than zero.
superseded_protocol_amendments.scientific_impact: No KERMT code, checkpoint, representation, panel, timing condition, or integrity threshold is changed. KERMT v2 timings remain native-path compute-throughput measurements but are not representation-equivalent across batch sizes. Partial job-1225272 outputs are archived and excluded; all encoders are rerun in one complete host/job execution.

gmolai.inference_path: repository-canonical optimized_gine_v1 with 48 allocation-bounded RDKit workers

interpretation.allowed_claim: descriptive single-pass end-to-end throughput on one fixed common panel, host, GPU and resource envelope
interpretation.forbidden_claim: hardware-independent speed superiority, GPU throughput for the CPU-only Morgan baseline, or representation-equivalent KERMT scaling when its cross-batch gate fails
